description: This is an implementation class for the HL7Service interface in the OpenMRS project, handling HL7 message processing, archiving, queue management, and patient/person identification mapping within the OpenMRS HL7 integration module.

classes.name: HL7ServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the HL7Service interface, providing methods for managing HL7 message processing, queue management, and patient/person identifier resolution within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setHL7DAO
methods.description: Sets the HL7 Data Access Object for database interactions.

methods.name: setParser
methods.description: Injects the parser used for parsing HL7 message strings.

methods.name: setRouter
methods.description: Injects the message type router that directs HL7 message processing.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Saves an HL7 source record, setting creator and creation date if needed.

methods.name: purgeHL7Source
methods.description: Deletes an HL7 source record from the database.

methods.name: retireHL7Source
methods.description: Placeholder for retiring an HL7 source; not yet implemented.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 source by its ID.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Fetches all HL7 source records.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 source matching the given name.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Lists all entries in the HL7 inbound queue.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7InQueue entries based on pagination and status.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7InError entries based on pagination.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7InArchive entries.

methods.name: countHL7InQueue
methods.description: Counts HL7InQueue messages matching status and query.

methods.name: countHL7InError
methods.description: Counts HL7InError records matching query.

methods.name: countHL7InArchive
methods.description: Counts HL7InArchive records matching status and query.

methods.name: purgeHL7InQueue
methods.description: Deletes a queue entry.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Saves an HL7InQueue object, initializing creation date and status.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves a queue item by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a queue item by UUID.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Fetches the next HL7 queue entry pending processing.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Gets archived HL7 messages filtered by state.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByState
methods.description: Gets queue entries filtered by state.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Lists all archived HL7 messages.

methods.name: purgeHL7InArchive
methods.description: Removes an archived HL7 message.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Saves an HL7InArchive object, setting creation date if needed.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieves an archive by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a HL7 archive record by UUID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a HL7 archive record by UUID, with check for active migration thread.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue
methods.description: Processes a queue entry, parsing HL7 message, routing it, archiving, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: setFatalError
methods.description: Handles fatal processing errors by moving queue entries to error storage with logs.

methods.name: parseHL7String
methods.description: Parses an HL7 message string into a Message object.

methods.name: getHL7InError
methods.description: Fetches an HL7 error record by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorByUuid
methods.description: Fetches an HL7 error record by UUID.

methods.name: resolveUserId
methods.description: Resolves user ID from XCN data type in HL7, by ID number or name.

methods.name: resolvePersonId
methods.description: Resolves person ID from XCN data type in HL7, by ID number or name.

methods.name: resolveLocationId
methods.description: Resolves location ID from PL data type in HL7 message.

methods.name: resolvePatientId
methods.description: Resolves patient ID from PID segment.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers
methods.description: Finds a Person object from an array of CX identifiers.

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks via DAO.

methods.name: loadHL7InArchiveData
methods.description: Loads HL7 data from filesystem location into archive object.

methods.name: migrateHl7InArchivesToFileSystem
methods.description: Migrates archived HL7 messages to filesystem, updating their data path.

methods.name: migrateHL7InArchive
methods.description: Handles individual archive migration to filesystem.

methods.name: writeHL7InArchiveToFileSystem
methods.description: Writes HL7 data to filesystem, organizing files by archive date.

methods.name: getHl7QueueItemByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves queue or archive record by UUID for privilege-checking and processing.
